tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle` read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, the floating tab bar and sheets. Floats on `background` with `shadow-card`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: inactive quick-action circles, segmented-control tracks, the check-in card.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and around cards in the dark theme. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: unselected chips, text fields. 3:1 on `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted` and the tint gradient.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, captions, helper text. 4.5:1 on `background`, `surface` and `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the least important labels. 4.5:1 on `background` and `surface`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Bloom raspberry. Primary buttons, the active tab, selected chips, links. Text on it uses `on-primary`.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary buttons and pills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Soft buttons, icon tiles in list rows, the avatar circle.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: hero-start
tokens.usage: Deep berry. Start of the hero gradient (top-left) for the one number that matters on a screen.

tokens.name: hero-end
tokens.usage: Plum. End of the hero gradient (bottom-right).

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Large numbers and headings on the hero gradient. 4.5:1 on both ends.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on the hero gradient. 4.5:1 on both ends.

tokens.name: tint-start
tokens.usage: Blush. Start of the soft tint gradient used for supporting cards (Cycle overview, the Learn banner).

tokens.name: tint-end
tokens.usage: End of the soft tint gradient.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive confirmations, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text. Pair with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of “worth knowing” and care notices.

tokens.name: on-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete all my data) and errors. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of destructive buttons and error notices.

tokens.name: on-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Colour of elevation shadows (see `shadow-card`, `shadow-raised`).

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Track of a switch that is off.

tokens.name: menstrual
tokens.usage: Logged period days (filled), predicted days (dashed ring), period phase marks. Never used for the brand.

tokens.name: menstrual-soft
tokens.usage: Soft menstrual fills (calendar days, badges).

tokens.name: menstrual-on-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `menstrual-soft`.

tokens.name: menstrual-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on `menstrual` (e.g. the day number of a logged period).

tokens.name: follicular
tokens.usage: Follicular phase marks in rings, badges and charts.

tokens.name: follicular-soft
tokens.usage: Soft follicular fills (calendar days, badges).

tokens.name: follicular-on-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `follicular-soft`.

tokens.name: follicular-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on `follicular` (e.g. the day number of a logged period).

tokens.name: ovulatory
tokens.usage: Estimated fertile window (soft fill) and ovulation (ring). Always labelled “est.”.

tokens.name: ovulatory-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ovulatory fills (calendar days, badges).

tokens.name: ovulatory-on-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `ovulatory-soft`.

tokens.name: ovulatory-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on `ovulatory` (e.g. the day number of a logged period).

tokens.name: luteal
tokens.usage: Luteal phase marks; also pattern dots for “before your period”.

tokens.name: luteal-soft
tokens.usage: Soft luteal fills (calendar days, badges).

tokens.name: luteal-on-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `luteal-soft`.

tokens.name: luteal-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on `luteal` (e.g. the day number of a logged period).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Brand only: top-left of the app icon gradient. Not for UI text.

tokens.name: petal
tokens.usage: Brand only: the leaves of the mark on light and dark grounds.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Brand only: the drop of the mark on the berry gradient and app icon.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and the numbers that matter. Tight tracking at large sizes.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The single big number in a hero card. Once per screen.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter for everything people read at length.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tap the first day of bleeding. An approximate date is fine.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Patterns describe what you’ve logged. They aren’t a diagnosis.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a big value.

groups.name: Wordmark
groups.note: Playfair Display is reserved for the “bloom” wordmark. Never set UI text in it.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo only — use the supplied artwork.

spacing.note: 4-point grid. Screens use a 20px side gutter.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges, text under a label.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps in chips.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and small items.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in a grid; row padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Space above section headers.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: space-huge
tokens.usage: Top of the welcome screen.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right page margin on every screen.

radius.note: Generous, soft corners; pills for anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles in list rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, notices, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large brand shapes and covers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, the tab bar.

shadow.note: Two soft elevations tinted with deep berry; black in the dark theme, where cards also get a hairline border.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups floating on `background`.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hero cards and the floating tab bar.
